text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, taking walk in park... Spotted 
Tucker Blair enjoying dancing.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text:
Phew~ Worked up great sweat! Call that 
enough for stamina training.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Trainer-san! That's right. Not just 
ordinary dance!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text:
Existing stamina training methods... hard 
to feel results, plain and brutal! Right?!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text:
That's where my proposal— "Smile Dance 
Exercise" comes in!!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text:
Dance as instructed, you'll see! Music, 
start!!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text:
Load power into knees, release! Load, 
release! Full power! Releaaase~~!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text:
Alright, don't forget to smile, 
tan-ta-taaan! Ride rhythm, hum-hum-huuum♪

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text:
Just as nature charms us! Aim to charm 
nature with dance!!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Good day, little birds! Good day to 
flowers too!!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text:
Sun and trees enchanted by your dance! 
Keep momentum going~~~—

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text:
Express joy with whole body! Follow heart! 
Whooo~~~♪

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text:
Now, finish! Let's nail pose sharp and 
clean!!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text:
Told you, right? Dancing lifts spirit! 
Body moves naturally, stamina gets built!!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text:
Make sure put today's lesson to good use! 
So trainees train with fun!!
